name: ck23yx-tracker-reminders
goal: Prove a journaled Tracker reminder disappears from the decision digest and status tick, reappears at its timestamp and sends one durable notification across restart and signed sync.

evidence: CLI and synthetic hub/spoke must preserve the decision and due date, hide the item from flagged status input and digest until the UTC instant, and wake the latest active reminder once through durable delivery. Red: native remind unavailable; direct notification leaked before wake; webhook had no scheduled delivery.
UTC reminder on the replicated item, visibility cutoff in digest and flagged reads, cancel and replace transitions, and hub receipt delivery through HTTP or the established CoS host binding.
Red CLI and notification fixtures reproduced missing behavior. Green: 45 focused cases and all three Tracker node E2Es on harbor-mbp-2, including status script dry-runs before and after the wake.
